Benzi queries the map and answers | What is Benzi | Most AI coding agents dump a repository into a context window and hope the model finds what matters. Benzi works differently: before answering anything, a real compiler — built on tree-sitter — parses every file in the project and resolves it into a precise, queryable map. Every symbol, every call edge, every reference, every class in its inheritance chain. One pass, done.",
  "key_claims": [
    "Benzi is a code intelligence tool that reads code before answering instead of guessing",
    "Most AI agents dump files into a chat context and hope for the best, but Benzi uses a real compiler (built on tree-sitter) to map every function and connection in the project first",
    "It creates a precise, queryable blueprint/map of the software (every symbol, call edge, reference, and class inheritance)",
    "It can answer complex questions about bug origins or data flow in a single, instant step",
    "It works across 10 different programming languages",
    "It turns a messy codebase into a clean, searchable structure",
    "Benzi is free to use and actively in development (work in progress)"
  ],
  "info_channel": "on-screen"
}
```
